description:
YouTube
==
- feat(YouTube - Hide ads): Add `Hide fullscreen ads` setting
- feat(YouTube - Settings): Add a color picker
- feat(YouTube - Settings): Match the search bar style to ReVanced (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2130 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2913)
- feat(YouTube - Swipe controls): Match with ReVanced (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2922 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2977)
- fix(YouTube - Hide comments components): `Hide highlighted search links` isn't working completely https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2949
- fix(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Simplifies the process of finding the selected audio track id
- fix(YouTube - Video playback): Allow custom speeds with 0.01x precision


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music - Hide ads): Add patch option `Hide fullscreen ads`
- fix(YouTube Music - Disable DRC audio): Patch not working on YouTube Music 8 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2927
- fix(YouTube Music - Spoof player parameter): Music played from search results is not added to `Recent searches` or `Speed ​​dial` https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2964

Announcement
==
- **There has been a refactoring of the settings, so please back up your settings before updating.**
- **There is a change in `options.json`. If you see warnings related to patch options, remove the `options.json` file or `Patch options`.**
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).
